adventure.title: Guided River Kayak Tour with Milwaukee Kayak Company
adventure.description: Paddle beneath downtown's bridges and skyscrapers on a guided river tour with Milwaukee Kayak Company.
adventure.bonus: Trade stories with your guide about the river's cleanup and comeback.

adventure.title: Trail Ride Through Three Bridges Park
adventure.description: Ride or run the two miles of trail and three pedestrian bridges through Three Bridges Park in the Menomonee Valley.
adventure.bonus: Cross all three bridges without stopping once.

adventure.title: Pickleball at 1st and Bowl
adventure.description: Rally across an indoor pickleball court at 1st and Bowl, Walker's Point's bowling-and-games complex.
adventure.bonus: Play winner-stays-on against the next open court.

adventure.title: Tour & Tasting at Great Lakes Distillery
adventure.description: Watch copper stills turn Wisconsin grain into gin and whiskey, then taste your way through the flight at Great Lakes Distillery.
adventure.bonus: Order the spirit you'd never normally pick.

adventure.title: Full Loop of the Milwaukee County Zoo
adventure.description: Walk the full loop of the Milwaukee County Zoo's nearly 200 acres past 2,200 animals from around the world.
adventure.bonus: Find the penguins and stay for a full feeding.

adventure.title: Ice Skating at Slice of Ice, Red Arrow Park
adventure.description: Lace up and loop the free outdoor rink at Slice of Ice, Milwaukee's own Rockefeller Center moment.
adventure.bonus: Attempt one spin, no matter how ugly.

adventure.title: Bouldering Session at Adventure Rock Climbing Gym
adventure.description: Chalk up and work your way up bouldering walls and auto-belay routes at Adventure Rock Climbing Gym.
adventure.bonus: Try a route two grades harder than you'd normally attempt.

adventure.title: Sunset Dinner Cruise on an Edelweiss Yacht
adventure.description: Glide down the Milwaukee River and out onto Lake Michigan for a sunset dinner cruise aboard an Edelweiss yacht.
adventure.bonus: Toast the skyline the moment the sun drops behind the bridges.

adventure.title: Full-Length Ride on the Hank Aaron State Trail
adventure.description: Ride all 15 paved miles of the Hank Aaron State Trail from the lakefront past the Brewers' stadium to the county line.
adventure.bonus: High-five the Hank Aaron statue if your route passes it.

adventure.title: Lakefront Ride on the Oak Leaf Trail
adventure.description: Pedal the lakefront stretch of the 125-mile Oak Leaf Trail with Lake Michigan on one side the whole way.
adventure.bonus: Stop at every scenic overlook you pass.

adventure.title: Crack the Code at Escape The Room Milwaukee
adventure.description: Race the clock cracking codes and hidden locks inside a themed room at Escape The Room in the Third Ward.
adventure.bonus: Whoever solves the final lock gets bragging rights for a week.

adventure.title: Beach Volleyball at Bradford Beach
adventure.description: Dig into a pickup volleyball game or wade into Lake Michigan at Milwaukee's most popular urban beach, Bradford Beach.
adventure.bonus: Join a volleyball game you weren't originally invited to.

adventure.title: Historic Tour at Best Place at the Historic Pabst Brewery
adventure.description: Tour the century-old Pabst brewhouse and sip three historic family recipes inside the Blue Ribbon Hall.
adventure.bonus: Toast with a stranger in the Captain's Courtyard.

adventure.title: Bucks Game at Fiserv Forum
adventure.description: Feel the arena shake as the Milwaukee Bucks run out under the lights at Fiserv Forum.
adventure.bonus: Learn the game-night chant before tip-off.

adventure.title: Vintage Bowling at Holler House
adventure.description: Bowl on the two oldest sanctioned lanes in America, hand-set by real pinsetters at Holler House.
adventure.bonus: Tip your human pinsetter generously.

adventure.title: Axe Throwing Night at AXE MKE
adventure.description: Stick a hatchet in a wood target across sixteen lanes at AXE MKE, Milwaukee's rowdiest axe-throwing bar.
adventure.bonus: Bet the group a round of drinks on who sticks the bullseye first.

adventure.title: Climb the North Point Lighthouse in Lake Park
adventure.description: Climb the spiral stairs of the 1888 North Point Lighthouse for a bluff-top view over Lake Michigan.
adventure.bonus: Count the steps out loud on the way up.

adventure.title: Aquarium & Submarine Exploration at Discovery World
adventure.description: Get hands-on with a two-story aquarium and a real submarine at Discovery World on the Lake Michigan shoreline.
adventure.bonus: Touch a live sturgeon in the aquarium tank.

adventure.title: Miller Brewery Tour at MillerCoors
adventure.description: Walk the Miller Valley brewhouse floor and finish with cold samples inside the Bavarian-style Miller Inn.
adventure.bonus: Guess the size of the brewhouse kettles before your guide tells you.

adventure.title: Comedy Brewery Tour at Lakefront Brewery
adventure.description: Get roasted by your guide while learning to brew on the self-proclaimed funniest tour in the country at Lakefront Brewery.
adventure.bonus: Volunteer to be the guide's target for one joke.

adventure.title: Round of Disc Golf at Estabrook Park
adventure.description: Throw a round on Estabrook Park's technical 18-hole disc golf course tucked along the Milwaukee River.
adventure.bonus: Loser buys the first round at the beer garden after.

adventure.title: Guided History Tour at the Harley-Davidson Museum
adventure.description: Straddle a vintage chopper and trace 120 years of two-wheeled rebellion through the Harley-Davidson Museum's engine hall.
adventure.bonus: Pick the wildest paint job in the collection and defend your choice.

adventure.title: Lantern-Lit Walking Tour with Brew City Ghosts
adventure.description: Creep through downtown's haunted alleys and hotels on a lantern-lit walking tour with Brew City Ghosts.
adventure.bonus: Ask your guide for the story they refuse to tell twice.

chill.title: Sunset Wing-Closing at the Milwaukee Art Museum
chill.description: Watch the Quadracci Pavilion's Calatrava-designed wings fold shut against a Lake Michigan sunset at the Milwaukee Art Museum.
chill.bonus: Time your visit to catch the exact minute the wings close.

chill.title: Pour-Over Break at Anodyne Coffee Roasting Co.
chill.description: Settle into the exposed-brick roastery at Anodyne Coffee with a fresh pour-over in Walker's Point.
chill.bonus: Ask the barista what they're currently roasting.

chill.title: Mansion Tour at the Charles Allis Art Museum
chill.description: Explore a Tudor-style 1911 mansion turned intimate art museum at the Charles Allis Art Museum.
chill.bonus: Pick which room you'd claim as your own if you lived there.

chill.title: 'Man at Work' Collection at the Grohmann Museum
chill.description: Wander galleries of industrial-era paintings and sculpture depicting laborers at the Grohmann Museum.
chill.bonus: Pick the painting that looks most like real work you've done.

chill.title: Island Loop Walk at Lakeshore State Park
chill.description: Circle the man-made island loop trail at Lakeshore State Park with the downtown skyline on one side and open lake on the other.
chill.bonus: Spot three different bird species along the shoreline.

chill.title: Gallery Hop the Historic Third Ward
chill.description: Duck into a string of independent galleries and artist studios tucked through the Historic Third Ward.
chill.bonus: Ask an artist about the piece you like most.

chill.title: Terraced Garden Tour at Villa Terrace Decorative Arts Museum
chill.description: Wander a terraced Italian Renaissance garden overlooking Lake Michigan at the Villa Terrace Decorative Arts Museum.
chill.bonus: Find the best hidden lake view spot on the terraces.

chill.title: Rooftop Patio at Cafe Benelux
chill.description: Claim a spot on the rooftop deck at Cafe Benelux and watch the Third Ward come alive below.
chill.bonus: Order a Belgian beer you can't pronounce.

chill.title: Kite-Flying Picnic at Veterans Park
chill.description: Spread a blanket on the lakefront green at Veterans Park and watch kites and sailboats drift over the water.
chill.bonus: Fly a kite even if you brought zero kite-flying skill.

chill.title: Tropical Dome Wander at the Mitchell Park Domes
chill.description: Step into eighty-degree humidity among 1,200 rainforest species inside the Mitchell Park Domes' Tropical Dome.
chill.bonus: Find the strangest-looking plant and photograph it.

chill.title: RiverSculpture Stroll on the Milwaukee RiverWalk
chill.description: Wander the Milwaukee RiverWalk past twenty outdoor sculptures strung along the water's edge.
chill.bonus: Pick your favorite sculpture and say why.

chill.title: Lakeside Coffee at Colectivo Coffee's Lakefront Cafe
chill.description: Sip a cortado on the lakeside patio of Colectivo Coffee's converted pumping-station cafe.
chill.bonus: Sit outside even if it's a little too cold.

foodie.title: Wisconsin Cheese Flight at West Allis Cheese & Sausage Shoppe
foodie.description: Sample a cutting board of Wisconsin cheddars and aged goudas at the West Allis Cheese & Sausage Shoppe inside the Public Market.
foodie.bonus: Guess the age of each cheddar before the vendor tells you.

foodie.title: Tequila Flight & Tacos at Blue Bat Kitchen & Tequilaria
foodie.description: Work through a flight from a hundred-plus tequila list over street tacos on the riverfront patio at Blue Bat Kitchen & Tequilaria.
foodie.bonus: Order the tequila you can't pronounce.

foodie.title: Walk-Up Concrete at Leon's Frozen Custard
foodie.description: Pull up to the neon-lit walk-up window at Leon's Frozen Custard for a hand-scooped concrete since 1942.
foodie.bonus: Order a flavor you've never had before.

foodie.title: German Dinner at Mader's Restaurant
foodie.description: Feast on wiener schnitzel and spaetzle under suits of armor at Mader's, Milwaukee's century-old German restaurant.
foodie.bonus: Find the hidden medieval knight statue and take a photo with it.

foodie.title: Bloody Mary & Burger at Sobelman's Pub & Grill
foodie.description: Wrap both hands around a garnish-loaded Bloody Mary and a Sobelman's Original Burger.
foodie.bonus: Count how many garnishes are actually stacked on your Bloody Mary.

foodie.title: Food Hall Crawl at Milwaukee Public Market
foodie.description: Graze from stall to stall — cheese curds, oysters, tacos — inside the buzzing Milwaukee Public Market.
foodie.bonus: Let a stranger's plate pick your next order.

foodie.title: Hands-On Pierogi Class at the Polish Center of Wisconsin
foodie.description: Roll, fill, and pinch your own pierogi by hand in a hands-on class at the Polish Center of Wisconsin.
foodie.bonus: Shape one pierogi into a ridiculous form and eat it first.

foodie.title: Supper Club Steak Dinner at Five O'Clock Steakhouse
foodie.description: Sit down to a candlelit steak dinner at Five O'Clock Steakhouse, Milwaukee's classic supper club since 1946.
foodie.bonus: Order the relish tray and try everything on it.

foodie.title: Old Fashioned Flight at Central Standard Craft Distillery
foodie.description: Taste your way through barrel-aged spirits and a proper Wisconsin brandy Old Fashioned at Central Standard Craft Distillery.
foodie.bonus: Order it 'sweet' like a local and see if you agree.

foodie.title: Sour Beer Flight at MobCraft Beer
foodie.description: Work through a flight of funky, crowd-sourced sours at MobCraft Beer's Walker's Point taproom.
foodie.bonus: Vote on MobCraft's next crowd-designed beer idea.

foodie.title: Flavor of the Day at Kopp's Frozen Custard
foodie.description: Chase down Kopp's rotating Flavor of the Day next to a double cheeseburger piled sky-high.
foodie.bonus: Ask the counter staff what tomorrow's flavor is.

foodie.title: Friday Fish Fry at Clifford's Supper Club
foodie.description: Dig into a golden beer-battered cod fillet and all the fixings at Clifford's Supper Club's classic Friday fish fry.
foodie.bonus: Order a brandy old fashioned like a true Wisconsinite.

social.title: Beer Garden Afternoon at South Shore Terrace
social.description: Grab a picnic table with a skyline view and pass around a pitcher at South Shore Terrace beer garden.
social.bonus: Start a lawn game with the table next to you.

social.title: A Night at the Pabst Theater
social.description: Take your seat under ornate German Renaissance details for a live show at the fourth-oldest operating theater in the country.
social.bonus: Look up at the ceiling murals before the lights go down.

social.title: Stein Night at the Bavarian Bierhaus
social.description: Raise a liter stein at a communal table while an oompah band plays inside the Bavarian Bierhaus beer hall.
social.bonus: Clink steins with every table within reach.

social.title: Stand-Up Night at The Laughing Tap
social.description: Grab a front-row table for a lineup of touring headliners and local comics at The Laughing Tap.
social.bonus: Sit close enough that the comic might talk to you.

social.title: Local Band Night at Cactus Club
social.description: Squeeze into Bay View's scrappiest music venue for a local band at Cactus Club.
social.bonus: Talk to the band at the merch table after their set.

social.title: German Tavern Hang at Von Trier
social.description: Sink into a booth under stained glass and antique ironwork at Von Trier, Milwaukee's historic German beer bar.
social.bonus: Ask the bartender the story behind the antler chandelier.

social.title: Live Show at Turner Hall Ballroom
social.description: Catch a touring band inside the National Historic Landmark ballroom at Turner Hall.
social.bonus: Push up against the stage for at least one song.

social.title: Rooftop Hangout at Camp Bar
social.description: Post up on the two-story, Northwoods-themed rooftop patio at Camp Bar in the Third Ward, fire pits included.
social.bonus: Toast marshmallows at the fire pit if it's running.

social.title: Improv Showdown at ComedySportz Milwaukee
social.description: Cheer on two teams battling in fast, audience-fueled improv games at ComedySportz Milwaukee.
social.bonus: Shout out a suggestion when the ref asks the crowd.

social.title: Concert at The Rave/Eagles Club
social.description: Push toward the stage in one of seven rooms inside Milwaukee's iconic multi-level rock club, The Rave/Eagles Club.
social.bonus: Buy a round for whoever's standing next to you in the pit.

social.title: Bowling & Arcade at Landmark Lanes
social.description: Bowl a few frames and feed the vintage arcade cabinets at Landmark Lanes, tucked inside the historic Oriental Theatre building.
social.bonus: Play the oldest arcade machine you can find.

social.title: Brewers Game at American Family Field
social.description: Watch the retractable roof frame a Milwaukee Brewers game from your seat at American Family Field.
social.bonus: Do the sausage race chant at the top of your lungs.
